message:
`<div>` with a mousemove handler must have an ARIA role
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_static_element_interactions

Using `on:mousemove` to listen to the mousemove event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onmousemove` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

`m` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
